en: A black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard-style panoramic view of a town with dense trees in the foreground and a hillside of prominent buildings in the background. Key structures are labeled in red German text: a large multi‑storey school building, two churches (one with a tall spire), and surrounding townhouses. The layout, typography, and architecture suggest an early 20th‑century European postcard.
